causes: Coolant flow reduced or blocked radiator/filter
sop: Apply lockout/tagout (LOTO) before opening any guard or cover
Check coolant level and flow; clean or replace the coolant filter
Inspect the cooling fan and pump for correct operation
Check lubricant level and condition; top up if needed
Reduce the duty cycle until the temperature stabilises
Record the reading and confirm it stays below the warning limit for 30 minutes
temperature.safety: Hot surfaces: wait for cool-down or use heat-resistant gloves. LOTO is mandatory before opening guards.

sop: Apply LOTO and wait for all rotation to stop
Check and torque mounting and foundation bolts
Inspect bearings for heat, noise and play; replace if worn
Check shaft alignment with a dial gauge or laser tool
Inspect the coupling and replace the insert if cracked
Run unloaded for 10 minutes and compare vibration to baseline
vibration.safety: Rotating equipment: LOTO and full stop before touching couplings or guards. Never measure alignment while running.

causes: Low oil level or aerated oil
sop: Depressurise the circuit and apply LOTO; release stored energy in accumulators
Look for oil leaks at seals, hoses and fittings
Check oil level and condition; take an oil sample if dark or foamy
Replace the hydraulic filter
Replace the seal kit on the leaking cylinder or valve
Re-pressurise slowly and verify the pressure against the nominal value
pressure.safety: High-pressure fluid can penetrate skin: depressurise first, wear eye protection, never check leaks by hand.

causes: Drive / VFD fault or wrong parameters
sop: Apply LOTO on the drive and motor supply
Read the VFD fault history and compare parameters with the backup
Inspect belt tension and wear; replace if glazed or cracked
Check the encoder cable and mounting
Measure motor insulation resistance (megger test)
Restart and compare actual speed with the setpoint under load
rpm.safety: Electrical hazard: only qualified electrical staff; wait for the DC bus to discharge; LOTO mandatory.
